job.job_description:
Responsibilities:

AI & LLM Engineering
Build and maintain LLM pipelines, model integrations, and inference workflows
Develop APIs and microservices that interact with AI/ML models
Optimize model performance, latency, and throughput for production use
Backend Development
Architect, design, and implement scalable backend systems for AI products
Create robust RESTful/GraphQL APIs and internal services
Ensure high system performance, uptime, monitoring, and logging
Infrastructure & System Design
Work with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) for deployments
Implement CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and automation
Manage databases (SQL/NoSQL) and distributed system components
Collaboration & Leadership
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (AI, product, frontend)
Provide technical leadership, code reviews, and mentorship to junior developers
Take ownership of end-to-end features from design to deployment

Technical Skills:


4-10 years of backend development experience
Strong skills in Python / Node js
Hands-on experience with:
LLM integrations, AI APIs, or conversational AI workflows
Distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture
Databases like MongoDB, Redis, etc
Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Experience with system scaling, performance tuning, and production architecture
Strong problem-solving skills and ownership mindset
